summary.name: RAG - Retrieve Context.step
summary.description: Asks a RAG collection one or more questions and outputs the matching chunks as a ranked table with their source location and corpus version - the same retrieval a deployed decision performs.

summary.name: RAG - Load Vector Store.step
summary.description: Loads embedded RAG chunks into the vector store (upsert-first-then-delete-stale), updates the promoted CAS ledger and outputs a per-document load report; credentials come from the SAS Viya credential domain.

summary.name: RAG - Embed Chunks.step
summary.description: Embeds RAG chunks through the governed SCR embedding container with thread-pooled calls; vectors for unchanged chunk ids are reused from the previous run automatically.

summary.name: RAG - Extract Text.step
summary.description: Extracts text elements from every new or changed document in the RAG inventory through the rag_core extractor registry; corrupt documents are marked failed without failing the flow.

summary.name: RAG - Chunk Documents.step
summary.description: Token-aware chunking of extracted RAG elements with deterministic chunk ids; chunk size is budgeted inside the embedding model's token window.

summary.name: RAG - Enrich Chunks.step
summary.description: Calls a manifested Prompt Builder prompt once per chunk and stores what it returns as the chunk's context header and as its own columns on the chunk table, so the embedding sees a chunk that says where it came from. Chain the step to run several prompts, one after the other.

summary.name: RAG - Register Setup.step
summary.description: Manifests and registers the retrieval model for a completed RAG ingestion, writes its governance artifacts, and generates the scheduled ingestion job from the Studio Flow that produced it.

summary.name: RAG - List Documents.step
summary.description: Crawls a document folder, fingerprints every file and diffs it against the RAG ingestion ledger; outputs the document inventory for the RAG ingestion flow.

summary.name: RAG - Purge Documents.step
summary.description: Permanently removes named documents from a RAG collection - chunks, retired generations and ledger entries - with a preview mode that reports what would go before anything does.

summary.name: RAG-Builder-UI
summary.description: RAG Builder single-file UI, served through SAS Job Execution as an HTML form (append &_action=form to the job URL).
